title: Cart total displayed one euro too high
actual: The API and data attribute remain 30, but the customer sees EUR 31.00.

title: Promotion discount displayed twice
expected: CG10 on EUR 30 shows a EUR 3.00 discount and EUR 27.00 total.
actual: The discount shown is EUR 6.00 while the backend still charges EUR 27.00.

title: Product action silently adds two units
expected: One add action creates one cart unit.
actual: One action sends quantity 2 to the real backend.

title: Quantity update submits one more than selected
expected: Selecting quantity 3 persists three units and EUR 30 total.
actual: The real cart is updated to four units and EUR 40 total.

title: Invalid login error is suppressed
expected: Rejected credentials leave the form visible with an authentication error.
actual: The backend rejects login, but the error component receives null.
